highlights.text: Received a special 'rockstar' moment and praise from host Salman Khan during Weekend Ka Vaar.
Teared up when Salman Khan spoke about his career struggles, comparing his journey to John Travolta and Bobby Deol.
An old video of him with Arijit Singh from Fame Gurukul resurfaced and went viral.
Was praised by Salman Khan as the house's only 'Rockstar', with Salman mimicking his famous dance steps.
Recalled his long friendship with singer Arijit Singh, mentioning that Arijit can play the sitar for seven hours straight.
Was tagged as 'bigg boss' by housemates during a task.
Left fans confused after making claims about having a wife and children.
Sent to the medical room after a fake medical emergency acting stunt inside the house.
Recalled winning Fame Gurukul over Arijit Singh, admitting he was not a good singer at the time.
Exclaimed funny definitions for Gen Z terms like 'situationship' and 'benching', entertaining viewers.
Threatened Aasif Khan during a heated captaincy task fight.
Was sent to the medical room after performing an over-the-top acting stunt.
Received public support from singer Arijit Singh, who called him 'Apna Rockstar'.
Nearly entered a physical altercation with Aasif Khan during the captaincy task.
Scared housemates with an 'Oscar-level' performance and said 'main normal insaan nahi hoon'.
Backed by Arijit Singh, who revealed he will watch Bigg Boss for the first time for Qazi.
Got into an argument with Yung DSA during the first captaincy task, reviving a 'baap pe mat jaana' row.
Drew comparisons to former contestant Shalin Bhanot.
Engaged in a heated exchange with Yung DSA.
Got into a verbal altercation with Kanika Mann after she expressed her dislike for him.
